title: chore(console): refresh vendored objectui SPA to 09e1b261
body:
## What

Refresh the vendored `@object-ui/console` SPA pinned in `.objectui-sha` from `2cfa36e9` → `09e1b261` (5 upstream commits) and ship the changeset that bumps `@objectstack/console` (minor).

## Upstream changes pulled in

- feat(studio): Access pillar — fourth content pillar (permission matrix) (#2196)
- feat(studio): 复制 (duplicate base) on writable packages in the builder landing (#2193)
- feat(fields): default relation pickers to inline "create related record" (#2192)
- fix(plugin-form): hydrate widget types on hand-authored subform columns (#2189)
- fix(fields): show line-item row actions always, not on hover (#2195)

## Verification

- `pnpm run build` (70/70) → `scripts/build-console.sh` exits 0, 34/34 deps tasks green, dist 42088 KB.
- Bundle canary `import/jobs` present — THIS framework's `@objectstack/client` is injected into the SPA.
- `check:console-sha` gate passes (dist stamp matches pin).
- `packages/console/dist` is gitignored and rebuilt in CI at publish.
